step.cmd: Determine if you have all the information needed to complete the request and if the address needs to be validated:

ul.li: If additional information is needed from the client, or if the address needs to be validated, fact-find to obtain the information and go to step 2. fact-find
If you have all the information needed, go to step 5.

step.cmd: Determine if the client was contacted during fact-finding:

ul.li: If the client was contacted, go to step 3.
If the client was not contacted and the additional information was not obtained to complete the request, go to step 10.

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Issue: Select Other .
Comments: Type “T4E request.”
Details: Type “Client requested T4E to be mailed.” Document any additional information. Refer to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
Select Save .

step.cmd: Determine if a change of address is required based on fact-finding:

ul.li: If yes, refer to Change of address and go to step 5. Change of address
If no, go to step 5.

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if a T4E is available on the Statement of benefits paid (T4E) Enquiry:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 6.
If no, go to No T4E available in FTS . No T4E available in FTS

step.cmd: Determine if the client is on the telephone making the request:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 7.
If no, go to step 8.

step.cmd: Advise the client that the T4E is available on MSCA and can be printed any time:

ul.li: If the client is not willing to print the T4E from MSCA, go to step 8.
If the client is willing to print the T4E from MSCA, go to step 10.

step.cmd: Review the reason and date for the T4E request:

ul.li: If the client is requesting a T4E after March 1, go to Reissuing a current tax year T4E after March 1 . Reissuing a current tax year T4E after March 1

If the client is requesting a duplicate T4E before March 1 and there was a change of address after the year-end processing cut-off date, go to Reissuing a current tax year T4E before March 1 due to a change of address . year-end processing Reissuing a current tax year T4E before March 1 due to a change of address
If the client is requesting a duplicate T4E before March 1 and there is no change of address, the request cannot be processed. Go to step 9.

step.cmd: In NWS, create an SROC as follows:

ul.li: Issue: Select Other .
Comments: Type “T4E request.”

Details: Type “The client requested T4E to be mailed before March 1 — request not processed.” Document any additional information. Refer to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: Determine if there is an AI WI for the T4E request:

ul.li: If yes, complete the WI.
If no, no further action is required.
